desc:
❄️ Frostvale is buried in snow. Grab a plow truck and clear it!

Plow the city streets, fill your blade, dump the load at a snow yard and get paid. Buy bigger trucks and wider blades, upgrade your rig, and work your way from quiet side streets out to the highway and the airport.

🚜 8 trucks, from a pickup plow to the giant Runway Titan
🔧 20 plow blades, up to the 30-stud Aurora Mega
🌨️ Server-wide blizzards with 2x cash
✨ Golden snow that pays 8x
🌲 Knock down trees, street lamps, mailboxes and snowmen
💰 Rebirth for a permanent +50% cash
🎁 Daily rewards, playtime gifts and daily contracts
🏆 Leaderboards for snow plowed, cash and rebirths

Drive with WASD and raise your blade with Q. Mobile and gamepad are supported too.

Like and favorite so you can find your truck again next snowfall!
